apply_rotation_transform_full_hadamard: apply hadamard rotation transform to a HuggingFace CausalLM model with full-dimension rotation
apply_rotation_transform_grouped: apply grouped hadamard rotation transform to a model with a specified group size
apply_rotation_transform_random_hadamard: apply random hadamard rotation transform to a model with online rotation enabled
apply_rotation_transform_fuse_online: apply rotation transform with online hadamard fused into weights for a LLaMA model
apply_rotation_transform_quarot: apply quarot hadamard rotation transform to a Qwen model with fp32 hadamard computation
